$comment: Skills built into Claude Code itself, which have no SKILL.md on disk. Once a session starts, the suggester reads the built-ins this Claude Code version actually has from the session transcript; this list only stands in until then, and fills in a description the transcript lacks.
code-review: Claude Code's built-in review of the current diff or a pull request for correctness bugs. Use when changes are ready to merge or a PR needs reviewing.
security-review: Claude Code's built-in security review of the pending changes on the current branch. Use before merging or releasing code that handles input, auth or secrets.
simplify: Claude Code's built-in cleanup pass: reviews the changed code for reuse, simplification and efficiency, then applies the fixes.
